name: goldfinger-ads
description: Goldfinger Ads expert team: a commander orchestrating four specialists — media manager (demand-to-launch full funnel), material manager (creative strategy), AI ad buyer (build/tune/diagnose/review), and Tencent Ads consulting assistant (rules & mechanics) — covering everything from 'I want to run an ad' to launch, monitoring, and wrap-up on Tencent Ads. Since v1.6.0 the Goldfinger MCP connector is decoupled from this package and installed separately (standalone MCP connector zip, OAuth) so the platform can fully identify the user identity; the package declares dependencies.connectors=[jinshouzhi] so the platform can hang the connect chip in expert sessions.
